user.title: TV Launcher Bridge
user.description: Start the TV Launcher Bridge add-on, then enter 127.0.0.1 and the API token from its Configuration tab. Existing installations can use the HA VM address.

reconfigure.title: TV Launcher Bridge
reconfigure.description: Start the TV Launcher Bridge add-on, then enter 127.0.0.1 and the API token from its Configuration tab. Existing installations can use the HA VM address.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach TV Launcher Bridge. Check that it is running and the address and port are right.

abort.already_configured: This TV Launcher Bridge is already set up.

launch_app.name: Open app
launch_app.description: Opens an app on the TV by name (e.g. Jellyfin) or package name.

close_app.name: Close app
close_app.description: Force-closes an app on the TV.

send_key.name: Press button
send_key.description: Presses a remote button on the TV.

key.name: Button
key.description: Button name, e.g. play_pause, home, up. Any Android key name also works.

play_show.name: Play show on Jellyfin
play_show.description: Turns on the TV, opens Jellyfin and plays a show or film (next unwatched episode unless season/episode given).

show.name: Show or film
show.description: Name as it appears in Jellyfin.

turn_on.name: Turn on and open Jellyfin
turn_on.description: Wake the TV and open Jellyfin first.

open_link.name: Open link
open_link.description: Opens a link (web address or app deep link) on the TV, optionally inside a specific app.

search.name: Search
search.description: Searches the whole TV, or inside one app.

type_text.name: Type text
type_text.description: Types into the text box that is open on the TV.

send_intent.name: Send command to app
send_intent.description: Sends an Android intent to an app (advanced: actions, deep links and extras).

adb_command.name: ADB command
adb_command.description: Runs any ADB shell command on the TV and returns its output. Must be allowed in TV Launcher Bridge first.
